designed.domain_description: Unit square domain D = [0,1] x [0,1] with a small Dirichlet cold patch on the middle of the left edge (label 3, y in [0.4,0.6]); a uniform volumetric heat source f acts on the whole domain.
designed.domain_description_rationale: The active mesh borders span the unit square; the declared x0/x1/y0/y1 are unused variables.

boundaries.name: Gamma_1
boundaries.definition: remaining boundary: bottom edge y = 0, right edge x = 1, top edge y = 1, and the left edge segments y in [0,0.4] and y in [0.6,1]
boundaries.rationale: No boundary condition is imposed there, so it is a natural zero-flux Neumann boundary; by convention a Neumann boundary is movable (design).

lagrangian.objective_description: Material cost plus dissipated thermal energy: J = int_D ell*chi dx + int_D lambda*chi*|grad u|^2 dx; minimized over the shape.
lagrangian.state_description: Stationary linear diffusion: -div(lambda*chi*grad u) = f in D with the Dirichlet condition u = 0 enforced through the field declaration (label 3).

lagrangian.penalty_used_rationale: Only one Dirichlet value (u = 0 on label 3) exists, so the field declaration enforces it and no 1e15 penalty term is needed.
lagrangian.check_units_rationale: Units of ell, lambda and f are dimensionally consistent with a temperature state.

optimization_config.hmin_rationale: About a quarter of the mesh size n=50 on the unit square, enough to resolve the trunk.
optimization_config.hmax_rationale: Matches the active mesh element size 1/50 on the unit square.
optimization_config.diffusion_rationale: Small smoothing on a unit-size domain keeps the interface sharp but stable.
optimization_config.v0_rationale: Unit initial level-set velocity matches the scale of the shape derivative (gradients about 10).
optimization_config.phi_rationale: Funnel seed rotated so the narrow end (half-width 0.2, covering the Dirichlet patch y in [0.4,0.6]) sits on the label-3 sink and the wide end reaches the far side; symmetric about y = 0.5, solid fraction about 55 percent.
